intro hfg
contrapose! hfg
assume hfg_eq_zero : f.mul g = 0
haveI : Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne := inferInstance
obtain ⟨h, h_in_strict_periods, h_pos⟩ := hΓ
obtain ⟨m, n⟩ := f.mul_eq_zero_iff.mp hfg_eq_zero
have : m = 0 ∨ n = 0 := by rwa [f.mul_eq_zero_iff]
cases this with m_zero n_zero
· have : f = 0 := by rw [m_zero, f.mul_zero]
  contradiction hf
· have : g = 0 := by rw [n_zero, g.mul_zero]
  contradiction hg
